annotations.text:
Verigence · Process Coordinator — a calm co-pilot. It greets the PC, says in one plain sentence what needs them, and hands them their jobs as cards with one obvious button each. Built for someone mid-20s with ordinary computer skills.

Sidebar and hero panel share the same gradient (start #00306e, blue→teal). Every journey shows a rail that fills with the brand gradient — blue at booking, mint at done. Type is Manrope. Blue = your action, teal/mint = done, a warm coral only for something old or returned.

DATA — everything here runs on existing Audit Core APIs except one:
  • What needs you / journeys / pipeline / open flags → work-items + landing-metrics (have it).
  • "Returned by System/TL" → nextActionCode; urgency shown as flag AGE (createdAtUtc) — there is no SLA field in the model, so no countdown.
  • "No action for 7 days" → computed in the Web UI from latestActivityAtUtc vs a configurable day count. No backend.
  • The ask sentence → Uc03AuditFlag.description (stored).

ONE new endpoint needed: GET /uc03/pc-stats?from&to&outletId → { bookingsCompleted, deliveriesCompleted, bookingsInProgress, deliveriesInProgress }. The UI calls it for the week / month ranges to fill the performance strip. Avg cycle-time tiles were dropped (not in that spec).

START OF MONTH / empty — no flags, no deliveries, nothing in progress. The hero flips to "You're all caught up", the counts show 0, and the working area becomes one warm invitation with Capture New Booking and a faint preview of the journey path. The page never looks broken, just quiet.
